decisions.rationale: Full name of the disease under study (complex glycerol kinase deficiency), a single specific disease with one definition; the whole phrase is preferred as the minimum necessary span.
Duplicate mention of the same specific disease in the abstract body; duplicate mentions are annotated separately.
Abbreviation CGKD is the short-form synonym of complex glycerol kinase deficiency and is annotated as its own mention.
Muscular dystrophy refers to a family of multiple specific muscle diseases rather than one specific disease with a single definition.
Muscle weakness is a general clinical sign/symptom term that does not name a disease or disease family, so it is excluded as a general term.
Mental retardation is a grey-area term covering a family of heterogeneous conditions without a single specific definition, so it is annotated as Disease Class.
Congenital adrenal hypoplasia is a named, specific disease with one definition (abbreviated AHC later in the text).
Glycerol kinase deficiency names one specific enzyme-deficiency disease; 'deficiency' is part of the proper disease name here, not a standalone general term.
Second occurrence of the abbreviation CGKD in the discussion section; duplicate mentions are annotated separately.
Duchenne muscular dystrophy is a specific, well-defined disease (one genetic disorder), so the full phrase is annotated as Specific Disease.
Abbreviation DMD refers to the disease Duchenne muscular dystrophy and is annotated as a separate synonymous mention.
Refers to one specific defined hormone deficiency condition (abbreviated GTD) rather than a family of diseases; 'deficiency' is retained as part of a specific disease name, similar to C7 deficiency.
Abbreviation GTD is the short-form synonym of gonadotropin deficiency and is annotated as its own mention.
Here DMD names the dystrophin gene locus in a list of genes, not the disease, so it is not a disease mention.

decisions.rationale: Duplicate mention of congenital adrenal hypoplasia used as the disease responsible for putative genes; duplicates are annotated separately.
Abbreviation AHC is the short-form synonym of congenital adrenal hypoplasia and is annotated as its own mention.
Here GTD refers to the disease for which putative responsible genes exist, so it denotes a disease mention, not a gene.
In the chromosomal ordering pter--GTD--AHC--GK--DMD--OTC--cen, GTD denotes a gene locus rather than a disease mention.
